verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any programmatic usage or billing API, cost export, or per-team or per-workload spend breakdown. Workspace budgets are a spend limit, not a breakdown. Per-function logs and metrics and the OpenTelemetry export cover observability, not billing. Environments are an organizational construct with no documented cost attribution, so all of these are adjacent features only.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can pull usage and billing breakdowns programmatically to attribute GPU spend by team or workload
